about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive) and the critical point
source.fit: Fitted to measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive): 93 values with stated uncertainties within 1 % from 22 articles, max deviation 0.97 %, and 161 values with larger stated uncertainties, kept where the fit is within them (they extend the range to 278.15 K); and the ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database critical point (563.05 K, 4423000 Pa). Between 559.33 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. The ChemSep vapour-pressure equation was not used: it deviates from the values within 1 % by -1.3 % (median, -2.9 % at most); see docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md.
